verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Kintsugi's MCP server is a developer tool that lets AI coding assistants query API docs/OpenAPI spec to write integration code (kintsugi-docs-6, -18, -29, -30) — it explicitly never touches tax data or answers substantive tax questions. There is no evidence of a founder-facing AI assistant that answers 'is this taxable in this state' or explains invoice tax treatment with citations from a rule base.
